headline: OpenAI Alignment proposes complementary metrics for monitorability and monitor-gated risk
summary: An OpenAI Alignment post proposes pair-matched comparisons for monitorability and a post-control risk measure for systems that reject monitored outputs and retry. The authors report synthetic tests designed to expose selection effects and apply the methods to historical OpenAI system-card rollouts. Their article says pair matching still leaves behavior-class and difficulty differences unresolved. This review has not independently reproduced the analyses.
